note: Questions the bot asks one at a time, like a doctor would. 'en' is English and 'ru' is Roman Urdu. type: text | choice | scale | multi_choice | age. Choice options have a canonical 'value' used by the rules, and a label per language shown on the buttons. Every question is skippable except the first. The red-flag check runs after EVERY answer.

questions.ru: Aap ko aaj kya takleef hai?

questions.en: How long has this been going on?
questions.ru: Ye takleef kitne waqt se hai?

questions.en: On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is it? (1 is barely noticeable, 10 is the worst you can imagine)
questions.ru: 1 se 10 tak, takleef kitni shadeed hai? (1 bohat halki, 10 sab se zyada shadeed)

questions.en: Is it getting better, staying the same, or getting worse?
questions.ru: Takleef behtar ho rahi hai, waisi hi hai, ya bigar rahi hai?

questions.en: Are you also having any of these? Tap all that apply, then Done.
questions.ru: Kya in mein se koi aur takleef bhi hai? Jo lagu hon sab chunein, phir Theek hai dabayen.

questions.en: How old is the patient? Pick an age group or type the age in years.
questions.ru: Mareez ki umar kitni hai? Umar ka group chunein ya saalon mein likh dein.

questions.en: Is the patient male or female?
Is there any chance of pregnancy?
questions.ru: Kya hamal ka koi imkan hai?

questions.en: Do you have any long-term health conditions? (for example diabetes or high blood pressure)
questions.ru: Kya aap ko koi lambi bimari hai? (jaise sugar ya blood pressure)

questions.en: Do you have any allergies, especially to medicines?
questions.ru: Kya aap ko kisi cheez se allergy hai, khaas taur par dawaiyon se?

questions.en: Are you taking any medicines right now?
questions.ru: Kya aap abhi koi dawai le rahe hain?
